name: JellyShowcase
description: Browse and request Seerr discover content from any Jellyfin client.
overview: Discover library from Seerr with request button, streaming platforms and collections.

versions.changelog: Fix: discover placeholders are now hidden as soon as the requested movie or series arrives in a main library.

First public release: requests created as the user (pending approval), authenticated plugin API, Request button in the web client (English/Italian), streaming platforms as tags, studios and collections, requested items kept visible until available.
